托马斯和其他人不知为何都被这眼前景象震住了，全场寂静，只有那暗地而至的音乐环绕，对我来说，在这个被毁灭笼罩的角落，我找到了一丝希望的光芒。

Chef Anthony Albanese is the perfect chef to create this recipe. His passion for cooking and attention to detail are reflected in the perfection of the sausage and the rich flavor of this sub.

4 servings
PT30M
PT30M

Ingredients

  • 4 Italian sausages
  • 1 tablespoon olive oil
  • 1 small onion, diced
  • 2 cloves garlic, minced
  • 1 bell pepper, sliced
  • 1/2 cup sliced mushrooms
  • 1 (15 ounce) can tomato sauce
  • 1/4 cup red wine
  • 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano
  • 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes
  • Salt and pepper, to taste
  • 8 Italian sub rolls
  • 4 slices shredded mozzarella cheese
  • 4 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
  • 1/2 cup grated provolone cheese

Instructions

  1. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
  2. In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion and garlic, and sauté until soft and fragrant.
  3. Add bell pepper, mushrooms, oregano, and red pepper flakes to the skillet. Cook for about 5 minutes until the vegetables start to soften.
  4. Add Italian sausages to the skillet, breaking them up with a spoon as they cook. Cook until the sausages are browned and the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees F (71 degrees C).
  5. Pour in red wine and let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce slightly thickens.
  6. Stir in tomato sauce and bring the mixture to a simmer. Let it cook for 10 minutes to blend the flavors well. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
  7. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
  8. Split each sub roll and place a slice of mozzarella, a spoonful of the sausage mixture, and 1-2 tablespoons of grated Parmesan on each bottom half.
  9. Top each patty with a piece of provolone cheese and place the top halves of the rolls on.
  10. Place the sub rolls on a baking sheet and bake for 10-15 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the rolls are golden brown.
  11. Let the sandwiches rest for a few minutes before serving. Enjoy your delicious Italian Sausage Subs!

解决WLAN连接问题可以尝试以下几个步骤：

1. 检查网络连接：请确认是否是WLAN信号强度不足或距离过远导致的断开。尝试靠近WLAN路由器或者移动设备。

2. 重启路由器和设备：断开路由器电源，并等待大约30秒后再重新启动，期间也重启一下您的设备。这可以解决临时的连接问题。
